description: Use when you need a chronological view of process and logon activity on one host while investigating it.

configuration.query: FROM logs-endpoint.events.process-*, logs-system.security-* | WHERE host.name == ?host_name | SORT @timestamp ASC | KEEP @timestamp, event.dataset, event.action, user.name, process.name, process.command_line, source.ip | LIMIT 100

host_name.description: Exact host name to build the timeline for.
